embershard_focus.rules: Slasher: gain spell power for its remaining floors.

keen_edge_oil.rules: Slasher: gain attack power for its remaining floors.

healers_brooch.rules: Slasher: healing potions restore additional health.

quickstep_charm.rules: Slasher: movement speed and mobility distance increase.

wand_of_cinders.rules: Slasher: spell hits build precision; the cadence hit deals 25% bonus damage.

giant_bane_grip.rules: Slasher: deal 16% more damage to elites and bosses.

flameheart_talisman.rules: Slasher: spell impacts gain an 18-pixel area burst.

starfallen_sigil.rules: Slasher: specials create a 45% echo impact once every 4 seconds.

heartwood_crown.rules: Slasher: recover 2 health on each floor entry.

phoenix_ash_reliquary.rules: Slasher: survive one lethal hit per floor at 1 health.

chronomancers_pin.rules: Slasher: periodically shave 0.4 seconds from active cooldowns.

worldbreaker_gauntlet.rules: Slasher: impacts gain power, knockback, and area.

crown_of_the_first_flame.rules: Slasher: specials gain 30% damage and a wider impact.

aegis_of_the_last_king.rules: Slasher: gain heavy mitigation and survive one lethal hit per floor.
